content: Me malabumuŋnit’walaŋ kutikutiŋiŋ
Bepaŋ, nu du hogok ganintilolat. Unduŋ doktiŋa fiit yonadine nadiweŋ.
Maŋgande, me hogohi tiŋa yalaŋ-me heki adi memik tinamuŋa naniwoliwolike tiiŋ.
Adi mede kadakaniŋ hinek mebinit mokit hogok naniŋfit tiiŋ.
Nu adi meheki u yabukahile hinek tiŋa yehitubu-lodadok yonadi kwanai tilat, iŋgoŋ adi yadi mik tinamiiŋ.
Nu titiŋ momooŋ tiyemilat, iŋgoŋ adi kibi toboniŋ titiŋ hogoli tinamiiŋ. Nu adi meheki u yabukahile hinek tilat, iŋgoŋ adi yadi nabukwihita tiiŋ.
Me kadakaniŋ niŋ nindapmaune memikne’walaŋ mede nadinadi kwanai tiŋa medeŋiŋ kameka tibek. Kaŋ ne’walaŋ memikŋiŋ niŋdi mede gineŋ kedem kamewek.
Me mede nadinadi kwanai tibek adi me u yomŋiŋ kedem tubumintamiŋa kameune yot fafaŋeniŋneŋ fowek. Tiŋa undugoŋ, ninadi kwanai tibek u me mede nadinadi medi nadiune u maaŋ kadakaniŋ unduŋ tibek.
Nu adi me u pilap hinek kumumbune
wapmihiŋiye adi behik mokit eŋ tamŋiŋdi yohoi mokit unduŋ hatineŋdok nadilat.
Eŋ wapmihiŋiye adi yaufit tiŋa nayo kwanai tiyaneeŋ. Kaŋ me niŋdi yot hogoli gineŋ itouneeŋ iŋgoŋ fiit yehikelekulune fooŋ uneeŋ.

Memik u me nolidi nemek miŋgiŋ kaŋ toboniŋ mu nobu tubu-udaneyembek, kaŋ meheki adi kedem buŋa kweli be nemek noli u maaŋ kedem moŋgotneŋdok nadilat. Kaŋ metam yokwet niŋkadehidi nemenemek hogohogok adi tuwadok nadiŋa kwanai tuguk u kedem moŋgodapmaneŋ.
Nebek niŋdi me wendok momooŋ adi mu timimbek nadilat. Be nebek niŋdi wapmihi behiknit mokit yoŋa bulaniŋgoŋ adi mu nadiyembek.
Nu adi wapmihiŋiye adi kumuŋ tineŋdok nadilat, kaŋ metam mindaŋ mintaneeŋdi me wendi’walaŋ wou kotigoŋ mu nadineeŋ.
Nu adi Yahwedi me weŋ’walaŋ mamaŋ-papaŋyedi koom kadakaniŋ tigiŋ u nadisuwekdok nadilat. Unduŋ tiŋa me weŋ miŋ’walaŋ kadakaniŋŋiŋ u mu tumolokulimimbek.
Yahwe adi kadakaniŋhikdok helemahelemaŋ nadisuluwaak, kaŋ metamdi adi’walaŋ metambopŋiyedok nadikauledapmaŋ tiyemneeŋ.
Me woŋ adi metam nolidok momooŋ nemu tiyemguk. Adi yadi me fiyewakahi eŋ me nemenemekdok baniŋ tagiŋ eŋ me welemulap nadiyagiŋ, adi heki adi memik tiyemiŋa widihikumuŋ tiluguk.

Koom adi me nolidi kadaka titiŋdok medehaki yeniluguk. Iŋgoŋ oŋ, kobuk adi toboniŋ negoŋ kadakawek. Adi Bepaŋdi metam noli momooŋ tiyemdok mu ninadiluguk. Unduŋ doktiŋa adi maaŋ Bepaŋ’walaŋ kahaŋŋiŋ u tuwot mu kahilewek.

Helemahelemaŋ adi meeniŋ nolidi kadaka kedem titiŋdok yenisilone tuluguk, doktiŋa medeŋiŋ wendi netok tinahukutŋiŋ unduŋ timilak. Mede wendi ime nabugoŋ folooŋ maaneŋ sinintawek, eŋ kitiliŋiŋ gineŋ buhumeŋ nabugoŋ sinintaneŋ.
Tiŋa undugoŋ, medeŋiŋ wendi dahidahi nabugoŋ tinahukulimimbek, tiŋa kiyegelep nabugoŋ gadiŋiŋ foloŋ youkilitiluwaak.
Memikneyedi mede kadakaniŋ hinek u naniiŋ. Unduŋ doktiŋa, Yahwe, du talik unduŋ foloŋ kibikoŋ malabumuŋ kedem yembeŋ.
Iŋgoŋ Bepaŋ Wapumne, du adi gigitmede agaŋ koom yoguŋ undugoŋ tiŋa nehitubu-lodaweŋdok nadilat. Du adi momooŋ tiŋa helemahelemaŋ nabukahilelaŋ, unduŋ doktiŋa nehitubu-lodaaŋ kotigoŋ nanagileŋ.
Nu adi me fofoŋnit tiŋa fiyewakaŋ, nebek niŋdi not tinamuŋa nehitubu-lodadok moŋ, doktiŋa welene gineŋ nadiwene tuwot mu tilak.
Nu adi tebele meledi fohebilune wolinikdi liwe tilak undugoŋ hinek hatihatinedi liwedok tilak. Tiŋa undugoŋ nu adi gwatak niŋ sububadi fedikulune ulak undiniŋ.
Nu nanaŋe mu naaŋ kamehep tiŋa halene, muune adi saŋiniŋnit mokit tiiŋ. Unduŋ tiŋa kigita tibene kitiline hogohogok adi gweheyedapmaŋ tiiŋ.
Kaŋ metamdi nabuŋa nanimpekit tiiŋ, tiŋa mebiguguŋ tiŋa nabugege tiiŋ.
Yahwe Bepaŋne, du adi helemahelemaŋ nabukahile hinek tilaŋ. Unduŋ doktiŋa nehitubu-lodaaŋ kotigoŋ nanagileŋ.
Unduŋ tiŋa du dagoŋ nehitubu-lodaaŋ kotigoŋ nanagitaŋ u miŋgilaŋgoŋ tubudakaleune memikneyedi u kaŋ nadidakaleneŋ.
Adi Bepaŋdi nehitubu-kadakawek u kedem yoneŋ, iŋgoŋ oŋ, du adi toboniŋ momooŋ tinambeŋ. Du me kadakaniŋ tinamiiŋ heki u yehimoŋgofoweŋ, kaŋ kwanai-mege nu welemomooŋ nadiwitdok nadilat.
Nu adi memikneyedi meka hinek tineŋdok nadilat. Adi mekadapmaŋ unduŋ tubune metamdi kedem yabuneŋ.
Iŋgoŋ nu adi mede wapum toŋa Yahwe niutumbait. Eŋ metamdi mulelem tiŋa niutumbadok bopnelune nu adi’walaŋ lekiŋgoŋhik gineŋ wou nintilowit.
Maŋgande, adi yadi me fiyewakahi yehitubu-lodaaŋ yabudokolak. Unduŋ doktiŋa metamdi mede gineŋ yapmeeŋ kumuŋ titiŋdok tuwot mu yenineeŋ.
